note: What a customized copy of Less Pull may rely on. Tier 1 needs no rebuild and survives every update. Tier 2 is a folder in the source that updates do not touch. Everything else is internal: it may change in any build.

keys.warmth: Extra Warmth as a strength 0–3 (0 = Off, 3 = Red; 1.5 = 50 %)
keys.automatic: true = Extra Warmth follows Night Shift
keys.appExclusions: dictionary bundle id → {name, grayMode 0/1/2, nightMode 0/1/2, customWarmth, warmth 0–100, enabled, allDisplays, peekDisplays}
keys.websiteRules: dictionary domain or exact URL → the same shape without name
keys.peekShortcut: {keyCode, modifiers} for Peek in color; grayscaleShortcut likewise
keys.peekEffects: {grayscale, warmth, nightShift} booleans: what Peek turns off
keys.peekActiveDisplayOnly: true = Peek acts on the display under the pointer
keys.iconClick: 0 = left click opens the menu, 1 = left click toggles Grayscale
keys.displayModes: dictionary display UUID → 1 (always defaults) or 2 (always plain)
keys.sessionPresets: array of minutes offered under Start a session
keys.callBackPresets: array of minutes offered after a session
keys.sessionRemindEvery: minutes between reminders past the end; 0 = never
keys.sessionGlow: true = the glow at the end
keys.showAdvanced: true = the advanced options are shown

hooks.note: An executable file named after the event. It is started and not waited for; its output is ignored.

resources.note: A file here replaces the sound of that name in every style. WAV, any length.

tier2.note: Updates may add files here but do not rewrite yours; a fork that changes only these paths merges cleanly. A Source/Customization/ folder with code override points is planned.

tier3.note: Source/main.m and every other file: internal. A change here may conflict with any future build.
